title_en: Lying Flat: Another Way to Live
note_en: Two comparison frames appear here. 与其A，不如B means "rather than A, better B": 与其拼命加班却买不起房，不如把心态放平. And 与其说A，不如说B means "it's less A than B": 与其说是在反抗内卷，不如说是对现实的一种无奈妥协 "it's less a revolt against involution than a resigned compromise with reality." The added 说 turns a choice between actions into a choice between descriptions.
